### Find Hidden Treasures from God
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/find-hidden-treasures-from-god-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Job 28:10
Points:
- Uncovering buried treasures requires intentional effort, just as miners tunnel through stone.
- God's goodness and blessings constantly surround us, but they often go unnoticed without active reflection.
- Painful seasons serve as dark tunnels where spiritual virtues like patience and holiness are forged.
- The greatest treasure discovered in the dark is God's personal presence.
- Slowing down to recognize God's active care transforms our perspective on ordinary life.

### God and God Alone
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-nov-4-2008-11590381.html
Passage: Job 28:20
Points:
- True wisdom consists of learning to see life from God's point of view.
- Biblical understanding means responding to trials with faithful confidence rather than panic or cultural compromise.
- Human intellect and advanced degrees cannot discover or produce true wisdom.
- Real wisdom originates in God alone and begins with reverent fear of the Lord.

### The God Who Can't Be Figured Out
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-august-31-2016.html
Passage: Job 28:24-25
Points:
- God perceives the ends of the earth and holds sovereign command over creation.
- The Lord has chosen to keep certain things hidden from human understanding.
- Finite minds are far too small to comprehend all that God is.
- Believers can rejoice that God is infinitely greater than anything they can put in a box.
